headline: Amit Shah Begins Three-Day Goa Visit
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has arrived in Goa for a three-day official visit starting September 5. He will chair the Western Zonal Council meeting and discuss strategic plans for the 2027 assembly elections.

headline: Over 1,000 Temples Destroyed Under Portuguese Rule, Says CM
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant claimed that around 1,000 temples were destroyed in Goa during the Portuguese regime. He remarked that the state's historical temple heritage was once even richer than that of South India.

headline: Koti Tirtha Corridor to Be Ready Within a Year
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the construction of the Koti Tirtha Corridor will be completed within a year.

headline: Goa Bans New Contract Jobs, Offers Regularisation After 10 Years
summary: The Goa government has banned fresh contractual appointments across its departments. However, it is offering a one-time regularisation pathway for contract workers who have completed 10 years of service.

headline: IAF Hero Abhinandan Varthaman Joins Goa-Based FLY91
summary: Retired Indian Air Force Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman has joined the Goa-based regional carrier FLY91 as a commercial pilot. This transition comes after his retirement from active military service.

headline: Goa to Reimburse Rs 3,000 Annually for Free LPG Cylinders
summary: The Goa government will provide Rs 3,000 annually to beneficiaries under its free LPG cylinder scheme. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant confirmed that consumers will receive their reimbursements by September 10.

headline: Jamshedpur Players Free to Sign With New Clubs
summary: Jamshedpur FC players are now clear to seek new opportunities and sign with other clubs after receiving their complete financial payouts.

headline: Goa Passes Advocates Protection Bill to Prevent Attacks on Lawyers
summary: The Goa Assembly has passed the Advocates Protection Bill, introducing strict penalties including up to seven years of imprisonment for assaulting lawyers.

headline: Goa Crosses Milestone of 1 Crore Domestic Tourists
summary: Goa has witnessed a massive boom in tourism, with domestic visitor arrivals officially crossing the one crore mark.

headline: Delhi Man Shares Remote Working Experience in Goa on a Budget
summary: A remote professional from Delhi went viral after detailing what a monthly budget of Rs 30,000 can cover while living and working in Goa.

headline: Goa BJP Backtracks on Passing Anti-Conversion Bill
summary: The ruling BJP in Goa has decided to stall the passage of the proposed Anti-conversion Bill.

headline: Tourist Criticises Family for Littering Cabo de Rama Beach
summary: A visitor to Goa triggered a public debate after calling out parents who allowed their child to relieve themselves directly on the sands of Cabo de Rama beach.

headline: South Goa Collectorate Building Awaits Real Relief Despite Repairs
summary: The South Goa Collectorate building continues to face structural problems and offers little comfort to the public despite undergoing years of ongoing repair work.

headline: Akkalkot Swami Samarth Temple Attracts Large Devotee Turnout
summary: The Akkalkot Swami Samarth temple in Goa continues to serve as a major spiritual hub, drawing crowds of devotees seeking blessings.

headline: Goa's Special Investment Region Project Faces Local Pushback
summary: The proposed Special Investment Region (SIR) in Goa has run into heavy criticism and opposition from local stakeholders and activists.

headline: Teenager Killed in Tragic Sonsodo Road Accident
summary: A fatal road accident near Sonsodo resulted in the tragic death of 17-year-old Abel Menezes.

headline: High Court Demands Stray Dog Census Data by September 8
summary: The High Court of Bombay at Goa has directed local authorities to submit the latest stray dog census data by September 8.

headline: Man Dies in Siolim After Stabbing Himself During Dispute
summary: A heated altercation in Siolim took a tragic turn when a man reportedly stabbed himself during the dispute and later succumbed to his injuries.

headline: Private Shacks in CRZ Must Now Register With Goa Tourism
summary: To tighten regulatory oversight, the Goa government has mandated that private beach shacks operating in Coastal Regulation Zone areas must register with the tourism department.

headline: Goa Passes Housing Law Allowing Joint Ventures
summary: The Goa Assembly has approved a bill that empowers the state housing board to launch projects through joint ventures and revenue-sharing models.

headline: French Navy Frigate Concludes Mormugao Port Call
summary: The French Navy frigate Languedoc has completed its scheduled port call in Mormugao, Goa, as part of its deployment in the Red Sea and Indian Ocean.

headline: Zayed Khan Reveals Secret Goa Wedding Ceremony
summary: Actor Zayed Khan shared that prior to their large public wedding, he and Malaika Parekh held a private, secret wedding ceremony in Goa.

headline: Har Ghar Fibre Work in Bicholim to Take 270 Days
summary: The local internet connectivity project under the Har Ghar Fibre scheme in Sanquelim and Bicholim is scheduled to be completed in 270 days.

headline: Goan Pilgrims Safe After Nepal-Tibet Flash Flood
summary: A group of pilgrims from Goa successfully completed their Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage after surviving a sudden flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border.

headline: CM Promises Solution to Karapur Project Row in Two Days
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has announced that a resolution to the ongoing dispute surrounding the Karapur project is expected within two days.

headline: Goa Plans Dedicated Mud Crab Reserve for Species Protection
summary: The Goa government is considering creating a dedicated crab reserve and offering special incentives to protect breeding mud crabs.

headline: Overpriced Garlic Naan Bill Sparks Debate in Assembly, Lands Cop in Trouble
summary: A dispute over a Rs 170 bill for a cheese garlic naan was brought up in the Goa Assembly, leading to disciplinary action against a local police officer.

headline: Goa to Align Engineering College Schedules With National Norms
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the academic and admission schedules for Goa's engineering courses will be aligned with national guidelines.

headline: Rs 30 Lakh Extortion Audio Clip Surfaces in Goa Project Investigation
summary: A voice recording detailing a Rs 30 lakh transaction has emerged, boosting an ongoing police investigation into a major extortion case linked to a Goa development project.

headline: Restoration Work of Historical Saptakoteshwar Temple Begins
summary: The long-awaited structural restoration and conservation project for the historic Saptakoteshwar temple has officially commenced.

headline: Goa Misses EV Adoption Targets Due to Inadequate Infrastructure
summary: The Goa government has failed to meet its targets for electric vehicle adoption, citing high vehicle acquisition costs and a lack of public charging stations.

headline: Goa Starts Digital Survey to Map Local Crop Cultivation
summary: The state agricultural department has launched a digital survey across Goa to accurately map and record the crops being cultivated by local farmers.

headline: New Goa University Vice-Chancellor Takes Charge
summary: The newly appointed Vice-Chancellor of Goa University has officially assumed control of his office to lead the academic institution.

headline: GIDC to Establish Plug-and-Play Offices in Verna
summary: The Goa Industrial Development Corporation is developing fully equipped, plug-and-play offices and research spaces at the Verna Industrial Estate to foster local businesses.
